text:
We must ask that Gym Challengers wear their
uniforms for all official events.\c
The opening ceremony marks the beginning of the
Gym Challenge...so you know what that means!\c
That’s right—I’ll need you to get changed as well!
Wonderful!\c\nYou look sharp as a pin. And that [VAR 01C4(0001)] there...\nThat really is the number for you!
Now we’re ready at last for the opening\nceremony for this year’s Gym Challenge!
